trace_observation: Round 3 lost. Public trace includes unresolved hits 22 and 14 after misses at 30 and 21.
weakness: Current posterior scoring only mildly favors placements intersecting unresolved hits: factor 1 versus 0.85. This can divert shots to unrelated ships before finishing known damage.
hypothesis: Reducing unrelated-placement weight to 0.20 while unresolved hits exist should improve target completion and reduce ambiguity from touching ships. This is a heuristic, not an established optimal policy.

selection: Candidate retained only if its local same-board mean does not regress; otherwise source and executable restored automatically.
